ATLAS · training-only appearance/reference gate

Frozen selected v1 classifier. No fitting, validation/test forward passes or new tyres. Original and proposed support photos are part of training data; support-photo results are separated from v1 queries. The proposed 18-case bank is UNTRAINED and must not be installed in the old model. Chroma/glare flags are image heuristics, not human paint/wear labels.

Train-only probe summary

Distinct-view reference proposal

Original RGB and the normalized-luminance preview are shown side-by-side. These are deterministic feature previews, not depth maps. More views of a tyre are not more independent tyres.

All training images

Atlas thumbnails are the original predicted visible 2D atlas. Probe scores use the named deterministic transformation; transformed pixels are reproducible from retained native RGB, valid masks and source rules. No held-out endpoint is used here.
